ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of Non-Existent DLLs From System Folders
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects DLL sideloading of system DLLs that are not present on the system by default (at least not in system directories).
Usually this technique is used to achieve UAC bypass or privilege escalation.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed, SignatureStatus, Signature

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\TSMSISrv\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\TSVIPSrv\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wbem\\\\wbemcomn\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WLBSCTRL\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wow64log\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WptsExtensions\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT ((Signed = "true" AND SignatureStatus = "Valid" AND Signature = "Microsoft\ Windows"))
